sentences.zh: 比利·布什那个星期六，对我来说，是一个试金石。比利·布什那个星期六向我展示了到底是谁在

sentences.en: Donald Trump's back.
sentences.zh: 支持唐纳德·特朗普。

sentences.en: All you had to do, and what he did, was go out and continue to talk to the American people.
sentences.zh: 你所要做的，也是他所做的，就是走出去，继续同美国人民对话。

sentences.en: People didn't care.
sentences.zh: 人们根本不在乎。

sentences.en: They knew Donald Trump was just doing locker room talk with a guy.
sentences.zh: 他们知道唐纳德·特朗普只是和一个家伙在更衣室里闲聊。

sentences.en: And they dismissed it.
sentences.zh: 他们并不当回事。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你们。

sentences.en: Thank you very much, everybody.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢大家。

sentences.en: Sorry to keep you waiting.
sentences.zh: 抱歉让大家久等了。

sentences.en: Complicated business.
sentences.zh: 复杂的事情。

sentences.en: Complicated.
sentences.zh: 复杂的。

sentences.en: Thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: I've just received a call from Secretary Clinton.
sentences.zh: 我刚刚接到克林顿秘书的电话。

sentences.en: So, at least on some level, Bannon was right.
sentences.zh: 所以，至少在某种程度上，班农是对的。

sentences.en: Even after additional women came forward and said, actually, this wasn't just locker room talk.
sentences.zh: 甚至在更多女性站出来说，实际上，这不仅仅是更衣室闲聊。

sentences.en: He'd actually done this.
sentences.zh: 他真的做过这种事。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: He's elected.
sentences.zh: 他当选了。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Look, the retribution for the tape was going to be a renunciation of his candidacy.
sentences.zh: 听着，对于那段录音的惩罚本该是宣布放弃他的候选人资格。

sentences.en: And instead, he was elected.
sentences.zh: 然而相反，他当选了。

sentences.en: She congratulated us.
sentences.zh: 她向我们表示祝贺。

sentences.en: It's about us.
sentences.zh: 这是关于我们的。

sentences.en: On our victory.
sentences.zh: 关于我们的胜利。

sentences.en: Maggie, what do you think that the Republican Party learns in this moment when Donald Trump is elected despite this video and their expectation that he will lose?
sentences.zh: 麦琪，当唐纳德·特朗普尽管有这段视频以及他们对落选的预期却依然当选时，你认为共和党在这个时刻学到了什么？

sentences.en: I think for the Republican Party, it was that they might not be in precise touch with their own voters because for many of them, there was a backlash.
sentences.zh: 我认为对共和党来说，是他们可能无法准确把握自己选民的想法，因为对他们中的许多人来说，存在着一种强烈反对。

sentences.en: Republican lawmakers quickly learned that a fair percentage of the GOP base was made up of Trump diehards, and they needed those backers to vote for them as well.
sentences.zh: 共和党议员们很快了解到，相当一部分共和党基本盘由特朗普的坚定支持者组成，他们也需要这些支持者为他们投票。

sentences.en: So, for a lot of Republicans, it's kind of like, why speak up?
sentences.zh: 所以，对许多共和党人来说，这有点像，为什么还要发声？

sentences.en: Because maybe your voters don't even want you to.
sentences.zh: 因为也许你的选民根本不希望你这样做。

sentences.en: And in fact, your voters may completely disagree with you if you do that.
sentences.zh: 事实上，如果你这样做，你的选民可能会完全不同意你的看法。

sentences.en: And they might turn on you.
sentences.zh: 他们可能会调转枪头对付你。

sentences.en: This is the balancing act that they have had to do time and again.
sentences.zh: 这就是他们不得不一次又一次进行的走钢丝表演。

sentences.en: Access Hollywood might have been the first of this kind of red line moment, but it was not the laSt.
sentences.zh: 《走进好莱坞》可能是这类红线时刻的第一个，但绝不是最后一个。

sentences.en: This is the kind of thing that goes on in non-democracies.
sentences.zh: 这种事只会发生在非民主国家。

sentences.en: You had the firing of the FBI director, James Comey.
sentences.zh: 你看到了联邦调查局局长詹姆斯·科米被解雇。

sentences.en: That when there is an investigation that reaches near the president of the United States or the
sentences.zh: 当有一项调查波及到美国总统或

sentences.en: leader of a non-democracy, they fire the people who were in charge of the investigation.
sentences.zh: 非民主国家领导人附近时，他们就会解雇负责调查的人。

sentences.en: You had the president's statements.
sentences.zh: 你听到了总统的言论。

sentences.en: Painted white nationalists and members of the alt-right as victims of what he described.
sentences.zh: 将白人至上主义者和另类右翼成员描绘成他所描述的那种情况的受害者。

sentences.en: After the protests and a death in Charlottesville.
sentences.zh: 在夏洛茨维尔的抗议活动和一人死亡之后。

sentences.en: When you're watching it here in person, they were not just seeing a press conference go off the rails.
sentences.zh: 当你在这里亲眼目睹这一切时，他们看到的不仅仅是一场失控的新闻发布会。

sentences.en: You were watching a presidency go off the rails.
sentences.zh: 你看到的是一个总统职位的失控。

sentences.en: You had the president.
sentences.zh: 你看到了总统。

sentences.en: The president of the United States is tired of so many black people coming to this country.
sentences.zh: 美国总统厌倦了如此多的黑人来到这个国家。

sentences.en: Quote, why are we having all these people from shithole countries come here?
sentences.zh: 原话是，为什么我们要让所有这些来自屎坑国家的人来这里？

sentences.en: Describing immigrants from, quote unquote, shithole countries.
sentences.zh: 在描述来自，引号里的，屎坑国家的移民。

sentences.en: You can't dance around it.
sentences.zh: 你无法对此避而不谈。

sentences.en: Those are the words of the president of the United States.
sentences.zh: 这些就是美国总统的话。

sentences.en: It brings back to the fore the suggestion he is not only contemptuous, but raciSt.
sentences.zh: 这再次让人想起他不仅充满蔑视，而且是个种族主义者。

sentences.en: And the list goes on and on.
sentences.zh: 这样的例子还有很多很多。

sentences.en: It's hard to believe, but new government figures out tonight show nearly 2,000 children have been separated from their parents at the U.S.-Mexican border from mid-April through the
sentences.zh: 这让人难以置信，但今晚公布的政府最新数据显示，从4月中旬到

sentences.en: end of May.
sentences.zh: 5月底，近2000名儿童在美国和墨西哥边境与父母分离。

sentences.en: However, Trump's going after law enforcement, the FBI, even the Democratic opposition as treasonous, that's his word, and top Republicans sit silently.
sentences.zh: 然而，特朗普在攻击执法部门、联邦调查局，甚至把民主党反对派称为叛国者——这是他的原话，而高层共和党人却坐视不理。

sentences.en: Again, we keep rising to this edge and then the tide recedes and that has happened every time for Trump.
sentences.zh: 同样，我们不断被推向这个边缘，然后潮水退去，特朗普每次都是这样。

sentences.en: Where are the Republicans warning President Trump?
sentences.zh: 那些警告特朗普总统的共和党人在哪里？

sentences.en: Is it because it's a Friday?
sentences.zh: 是因为今天是星期五吗？

sentences.en: Is it because the president is overseas?
sentences.zh: 是因为总统在海外吗？

sentences.en: Or is it because so few people were actually surprised by this news?
sentences.zh: 还是因为其实很少有人对这个消息感到惊讶？

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And each time one of these things happens, Republicans seem to learn the same lesson each time.
sentences.zh: 而且每当发生这类事情时，共和党人似乎每次都吸取同样的教训。

sentences.en: The Republicans are looking towards their primaries.
sentences.zh: 共和党人在展望他们的党内初选。

sentences.en: They know that Trump is still very powerful.
sentences.zh: 他们知道特朗普依然权势熏天。

sentences.en: And what every member of Congress wants is to get reelected.
sentences.zh: 而每一位国会议员都想连任。

sentences.en: And if they think they're going to be primaried from the right or from the populist side of the party, I don't think they're inclined to speak out.
sentences.zh: 如果他们认为自己会在党内初选中受到来自右翼或民粹主义派别的挑战，我认为他们就不大可能大声发声。

sentences.en: They've learned that they have to balance maintaining their own jobs and their own offices and their own ability to get elected with speaking out.
sentences.zh: 他们已经认识到，他们必须在保住自己的工作、职位以及当选能力与大声直言之间取得平衡。

sentences.en: With that being said, all I can do is ask the question.
sentences.zh: 话虽如此，我能做的也只有提出问题。

sentences.en: My people came to me.
sentences.zh: 我的人来找我。

sentences.en: Dan Coats came to me and some others.
sentences.zh: 丹·科茨来找我，还有其他一些人。

sentences.en: They said they think it's Russia.
sentences.zh: 他们说他们认为这是俄罗斯干的。

sentences.en: I have President Putin.
sentences.zh: 我有普京总统。

sentences.en: He just said it's not Russia.
sentences.zh: 他刚刚说这不是俄罗斯干的。

sentences.en: I will say this.
sentences.zh: 我要这么说。

sentences.en: I don't see any reason why it would be.
sentences.zh: 我看不出有什么理由会是他们。

sentences.en: But I really do want to see the server.
sentences.zh: 但我真的很想看看服务器。

sentences.en: Maggie, the reason why we're talking about this Access Hollywood video with you right now is because of Trump's decision to take Putin's word over his own intelligence agencies
sentences.zh: 麦琪，我们现在和你讨论这个《走进好莱坞》的录影带，是因为特朗普在涉及2016年大选俄罗斯干预的问题时，

sentences.en: when it comes to the Russian meddling in the 2016 election.
sentences.zh: 选择相信普京的话，而不是他自己的情报机构。

sentences.en: And it feels like this is kind of a new line in the sand moment, a new Access Hollywood moment.
sentences.zh: 感觉这有点像一个新的划清界限的时刻，一个新的《走进好莱坞》时刻。

sentences.en: And once again, people are wondering, is this the moment where things actually change?
sentences.zh: 人们再次想知道，这会不会是事情真正改变的时刻？

sentences.en: What strikes you as similar about these moments?
sentences.zh: 在这些时刻中，有什么让你觉得相似的地方？

sentences.en: Look, both instances, these were self-inflicted, right?
sentences.zh: 听着，这两个例子都是咎由自取，对吧？

sentences.en: This is not like Charlottesville, where he was commenting on something that had taken place and he caused himself damage, but it was an external event.
sentences.zh: 这不像在夏洛茨维尔，当时他对已经发生的事情发表评论，并给自己造成了损害，但那是一个外部事件。

sentences.en: These are both self-inflicted and incidents that were on tape.
sentences.zh: 这两起都是自作自受，并且都有录音为证。

sentences.en: I have great confidence in my intelligence people, but I will tell you that President Putin was extremely strong and powerful in his denial today.
sentences.zh: 我对我的情报人员充满信心，但我必须告诉你，普京总统今天的否认非常坚定有力。

sentences.en: And what he did is an incredible offer.
sentences.zh: 他所做的是一个令人难以置信的提议。

sentences.en: He offered to have...
sentences.zh: 他提议让……

sentences.en: And earlier today, ahead of this conversation that we're having on air, you and I, Maggie, were talking about the similarities between these two situations.
sentences.zh: 就在今天早些时候，在我们正在进行的这次直播对话之前，你和我，麦琪，曾讨论过这两种情况的相似之处。

sentences.en: And you noted that a few months after the Access Hollywood tape, the president came out and said, you know what?
sentences.zh: 你指出，在《走进好莱坞》录音事件几个月后，总统出来说，你知道吗？

sentences.en: I'm not even sure that was my voice.
sentences.zh: 我甚至不确定那是不是我的声音。

sentences.en: I'm not sure it was even me.
sentences.zh: 我不确定那甚至是不是我。

sentences.en: And 15 minutes after talking to you, the president held a press conference about this news conference in Helsinki, where he basically did the same thing.
sentences.zh: 就在跟你谈话15分钟后，总统就赫尔辛基新闻发布会召开了新闻发布会，他在会上基本上做了同样的事情。

sentences.en: That's true.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: He did a version of, I didn't say what you heard me say.
sentences.zh: 他搞了一种变形，即我没有说过你们听见我说的话。

sentences.en: Now, I have to say, I came back and I said, what is going on?
sentences.zh: 现在，我必须说，我回来后说过，这到底是怎么回事？

sentences.en: What's the big deal?
sentences.zh: 这有什么大不了的？

sentences.en: So I got a transcript.
sentences.zh: 所以我拿到了一份文字记录。

sentences.en: I reviewed it.
sentences.zh: 我审阅了它。

sentences.en: I actually went out and reviewed a clip of an answer that I gave.
sentences.zh: 我实际上出去回顾了我当时回答的一个片段。

sentences.en: And I realized that there is a need for some clarification.
sentences.zh: 我意识到确实有必要做一些澄清。

sentences.en: He invited reporters into the cabinet room where he was meeting with members of Congress.
sentences.zh: 他邀请记者进入内阁会议室，当时他正在那里与国会议员会面。

sentences.en: And he was reading from a statement.
sentences.zh: 他当时在宣读一份声明。

sentences.en: And his explanation for what had happened in Russia was that he actually does accept the findings of the intelligence community.
sentences.zh: 他对俄罗斯事件发生经过的解释是，他实际上接受情报界的调查结果。

sentences.en: And a key sentence in my remarks, I said the word would instead of wouldn't.
sentences.zh: 我发言中的一个关键句子，我把would（会）说成了wouldn't（不会）。

sentences.en: And that he had meant to say when he said he didn't know why Russia would do that, meaning medal in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 当他说他不知道为什么俄罗斯会这样做——意思是干预美国

sentences.en: election, he meant to say he didn't know why wouldn't Russia do that.
sentences.zh: 大选时，他的本意是说他不知道为什么俄罗斯不会这样做。

sentences.en: The sentence should have been, I don't see any reason why I wouldn't or why it wouldn't be Russian.
sentences.zh: 这句话本应该是，我看不出有什么理由我不会或者为什么不可能是俄罗斯。

sentences.en: So it isn't really even a sentence that makes sense if you play it back to yourself.
sentences.zh: 所以如果你自己回放一下，这甚至都不是一句说得通的话。

sentences.en: Sort of a double negative.
sentences.zh: 有点像双重否定。

sentences.en: So you can put that in.
sentences.zh: 所以你可以把这个放进去。

sentences.en: And I think that probably clarifies things pretty good by itself.
sentences.zh: 我想这本身大概把事情澄清得差不多了。

sentences.en: And why is he doing that if the lesson is that everything doesn't really matter anyway?
sentences.zh: 如果教训是反正一切都无所谓，那他为什么还要这么做？

sentences.en: There is no enormous consequence.
sentences.zh: 又没有什么巨大的后果。

sentences.en: Why is he even bothering to say that?
sentences.zh: 他为什么还要费心去说这些？

sentences.en: Well, because he's getting a lot of criticism in the media, particularly media that really likes him.
sentences.zh: 嗯，因为他在媒体上遭到了很多批评，特别是那些非常喜欢他的媒体。

sentences.en: Well, and you're standing next to Vladimir Putin, whose ultimate goal in life is to undermine our democracy.
sentences.zh: 嗯，而且你当时站在弗拉基米尔·普京旁边，他此生终极目标就是破坏我们的民主制度。

sentences.en: So it was that one moment that you had to stand up for your own country, to stand up for your intelligence community.
sentences.zh: 所以那是你必须挺身而出捍卫自己国家、捍卫情报界的唯一时刻。

sentences.en: And as we've said this morning, he did not do that.
sentences.zh: 正如我们今天早上所说的那样，他没有做到这一点。

sentences.en: He has tweeted out since.
sentences.zh: 他此后一直在发推特。

sentences.en: His friends on Fox and Friends in the morning.
sentences.zh: 他在早间节目《福克斯与朋友》上的那些朋友们。

sentences.en: And I will say this to the president.
sentences.zh: 我要对总统说这句话。

sentences.en: When Newt Gingrich, when General Jack Keene, when Matt Schlapp say the president fell short and made our intelligence apparatus look bad, I think it's time to pay attention.
sentences.zh: 当纽特·金里奇、杰克·基恩将军、马特·施拉普说总统表现拉胯、让我们的情报机构难堪时，我认为是时候引起注意了。

sentences.en: They were pretty tough on him speaking directly to the camera.
sentences.zh: 他们对着镜头发表的言论相当严厉。

sentences.en: Nobody's perfect, especially in 10 intense days of summits, private meetings.
sentences.zh: 没有人是完美的，尤其是在经历了10天紧张的峰会和闭门会议之后。

sentences.en: Knowing that he was watching, most likely.
sentences.zh: 明知他很可能在看着。

sentences.en: But that moment is the one that's going to stand out unless he comes out and corrects it.
sentences.zh: 但那个时刻将会脱颖而出，除非他出来纠正。

sentences.en: Well, look, he's very, very susceptible to that criticism.
sentences.zh: 好吧，听着，他非常、非常容易受到这种批评的影响。

sentences.en: He's incredibly attuned to media coverage.
sentences.zh: 他对媒体报道极其敏感。

sentences.en: And in both cases, the media coverage was savage and intense.
sentences.zh: 在这两种情况下，媒体的报道都是狂热而激烈的。

sentences.en: And he was aware of it.
sentences.zh: 他是意识到了这一点的。

sentences.en: So in both cases, he did a course correction to try to change the media coverage, change the media narrative.
sentences.zh: 所以在两种情况下，他都进行了路线修正，试图改变媒体报道，改变媒体叙事。

sentences.en: Maggie, can we expect anything meaningful to change after the president's extraordinary
sentences.zh: 麦琪，在总统周一发表不同寻常的

sentences.en: remarks on Monday and the backlash that's ensued, given everything that you have just described, the lessons of the Access Hollywood video?
sentences.zh: 言论以及随后引发的强烈反弹之后，鉴你刚刚所描述的一切、《走进好莱坞》视频的教训，我们能期待有什么实质性的改变吗？

sentences.en: The only possible meaningful change could be at two points.
sentences.zh: 唯一可能产生实质性改变的地方只有两个。

sentences.en: And one is going to be the vote on the Supreme Court, where I don't anticipate this is going to influence it very much.
sentences.zh: 一个是最高法院的大法官提名投票，我预计这不会对它产生太大影响。

sentences.en: And the other is the midterm elections, where it might.
sentences.zh: 另一个是中期选举，可能会有影响。

sentences.en: Whether it will end up mattering, I don't know.
sentences.zh: 至于最终是否重要，我不知道。

sentences.en: But I think it's too soon to say whether this one has legs or doesn't.
sentences.zh: 但我觉得现在说这件事会不会持续发酵还为时过早。

sentences.en: So I wonder if one way of thinking about all this is that this series of events, the Access
sentences.zh: 所以我很好奇，思考这一切的一种方式是否是：这一系列事件中，《走进好莱坞》

sentences.en: Hollywood tape comes out, Republicans feel like they have to speak out against it, and then still Trump is elected.
sentences.zh: 录音曝光，共和党人觉得他们必须对此表示反对，然而特朗普最终还是当选了。

sentences.en: I wonder if that deeply unsettled Republicans into feeling like they don't really understand
sentences.zh: 我想知道，这是否让共和党人深感不安，觉得自己其实并不真正了解

sentences.en: their own party and voters, and that controversy after controversy since then, that sense has only
sentences.zh: 他们自己的政党和选民，而且自那以后争议不断，这种感觉不仅没有减弱，反而

sentences.en: gotten stronger, that they've not quite been sure how their voters are feeling about what's going on.
sentences.zh: 更加强烈，他们一直不太确定自己的选民对正在发生的事情究竟作何感想。

sentences.en: And that the midterms may be the moment that they're waiting for to find out.
sentences.zh: 而期中选举可能是他们一直在等待以找出答案的时刻。

sentences.en: I think that's definitely true.
sentences.zh: 我认为这绝对是真的。

sentences.en: I think that absent any new information, I think that this lather, rinse, repeat pattern
sentences.zh: 我认为在没有任何新信息的情况下，我认为这种老一套的模式

sentences.en: we have seen of Trump does something extraordinary, the party walks up to the line of doing something dramatic but doesn't, and then life moves on, will continue.
sentences.zh: 我们所看到的特朗普做出非同寻常的事情，党内走到采取戏剧性行动的边缘却没有这样做，然后生活继续，这种模式将会持续下去。

sentences.en: I think that Republicans continue to be disoriented and unsure of where their voters are.
sentences.zh: 我认为共和党人仍然感到迷失方向，不确定他们的选民在哪里。

sentences.en: They know where Trump's voters are, but that doesn't mean that they know where the broader
sentences.zh: 他们知道特朗普的选民在哪里，但这并不意味着他们知道更广泛的

sentences.en: Republican Party electorate is.
sentences.zh: 共和党选民群体在哪里。

sentences.en: And I think they are going to continue sort of groping their way through, and they're going to wait to see what the midterms tell us about where voters are.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为他们会继续摸索前行，他们会等待期中选举告诉我们选民都在哪里。

sentences.en: Maggie, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 玛吉，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: Michael, thank you.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔，谢谢你。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用程序？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 解锁了？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to the Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 众所周知，你需要订阅《时报》才能查阅所有报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore the Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但是，如果你可以免费探索《时报》一个月，且无需输入信用卡，会怎么样呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download the New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你首次下载《纽约时报》应用程序时，你在该应用中的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 有一个月的时间突破付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能获得什么。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to the New York Times, download the Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，请在今天下载《时报》应用程序，并获得30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天需要了解的其他内容。

sentences.en: The Times reports that President Trump's reversal on Tuesday came after intense private pressure from congressional Republicans, as well as his own advisers and allies on Fox
sentences.zh: 《时报》报道称，特朗普总统周二的立场反转是在来自国会共和党人，以及他自己在福克斯

sentences.en: News.
sentences.zh: 新闻上的顾问和盟友的巨大私下压力之后发生的。

sentences.en: Do you feel like there's trust both with you and with the Republican conference, with how the president has approached Europe, how the president has approached Russia over the
sentences.zh: 你觉得无论是你还是共和党党团会议，对于总统处理欧洲问题、总统在过去

sentences.en: course of the last 100?
sentences.zh: 一百天里处理俄罗斯问题的方式，是否存在信任？

sentences.en: Look, I'm not here to critique anyone else.
sentences.zh: 听着，我不是来批评其他任何人的。

sentences.en: I'm here to speak it for myself, and you've heard from others.
sentences.zh: 我是来为自己发声的，你们也听过其他人的看法了。

sentences.en: Publicly, however, Senate Majority Leader Mitch McConnell continued to refrain from criticizing
sentences.zh: 然而，在公开场合，参议院多数党领袖米奇·麦康奈尔继续避免直接批评

sentences.en: Trump directly, but told reporters that Russia is no friend of the United States and warned that Congress would take measures against it if it continued to meddle.
sentences.zh: 特朗普，但他告诉记者，俄罗斯不是美国的敌人，并警告说如果俄罗斯继续干预，国会将采取针对它的措施。

sentences.en: I think the Russians need to know that there are a lot of us who fully understand what happened in 2016, and it really better not happen again in 2018.
sentences.zh: 我认为俄罗斯人需要知道，我们当中有很多人完全理解2016年发生了什么，2018年真的最好不要再发生。

sentences.en: Senate Democrats, led by Minority Leader Chuck Schumer, called that approach insufficient.
sentences.zh: 由少数党领袖查克·舒默领导的参议院民主党人称这种做法是不够的。

sentences.en: So now the question looMs.
sentences.zh: 所以现在问题悬而未决。

sentences.en: What will the Senate do in response?
sentences.zh: 参议院将采取什么行动来回应？

sentences.en: Republicans seem to be shrugging their shoulders, some of them, claiming they've done all they can.
sentences.zh: 共和党人似乎在耸耸肩膀，其中一些人声称他们已经尽力了。

sentences.en: Statements are not enough.
sentences.zh: 声明是不够的。

sentences.en: We need action.
sentences.zh: 我们需要行动。

sentences.en: And we cannot act unless our Republicans join us in bipartisan action.
sentences.zh: 如果我们的人民党不加入我们进行两党合作，我们就无法采取行动。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 《每日秀》就到这里。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴尔巴罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 本周在《电线切割机秀》上，我们正准备迎接假期的到来。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 收听节目，获取让您的客人宾至如归的秘诀。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是全黑睡眠者吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们是否喝得不省人事去睡觉。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他们需要什么样的光线？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这是一个非常具体的事情。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症、食物敏感吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们是喝咖啡还是喝茶的人？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.en: On the New York Times app or wherever you like to listen.
sentences.zh: 在《纽约时报》应用程序上或在您喜欢收听的任何地方。
